_comment: Official NSE trading-holiday calendar, by year. Cross-checked against Zerodha and Groww's published 2026 NSE holiday lists (Sep 2026). This is a plain static data file, not a database — to add/revise a year, just add or edit its entry here; no code change needed. Dates falling on a weekend are naturally already non-trading days and are omitted unless NSE separately flags them (e.g. Muhurat Trading days are a special session, not a holiday, so are intentionally not listed).
